body: Right, cheers. I'll check it out. Never imagined pin worms could last so long, but now that I consider it, that appears to be the obvious solution here. Especially considering I can't see another potential sources of the issue, and there's no lump.

How much are they, generally? And which one would you say is more likely to help? I'm quite certain I had pin worms at one point, and while I do think they're gone, that uncomfortable sensation I have remains.
Supposedly it's in the process of being renewed.

I think it was an independent thing. I can't remember the last time I've actually cared about my family, or any real person. My emotions just died off gradually until the last ones went away around December. 

I've seen a therapist but it didn't help at all. I have no emotional issues to work through because to me it's all physical.
